description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the ReviewKpiAPI within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It contains test cases for retrieving all KPIs, as well as tests for create and delete operations, which are not implemented. The class extends a base endpoint integration test case and uses mock services to validate API behaviors.

classes.name: ReviewKpiAPITest
